author: PeterSchiff
text: 10-year Treasury yields hit 5.04%, a 20-year high and 30-year yields hit 5.4%, a 24-year high. The rise is neither temporary nor close to over. It's the start of a long-overdue reset that'll return interest rates to levels incompatible with current asset prices or debt burdens.
